title: Daily health on Progress
highlights: Active calories chart now shows your full Health Connect daily total—strength workouts, cardio, and everyday activity—not only logged cardio sessions.
New average heart rate chart uses the same 14-day daily totals as steps.
Health Connect daily metrics refresh when you open the app or return from the background, not only when you visit Progress.

title: Smarter stretch generation
highlights: Settings → Your Week now has Stretches per day—pick how many warm-up and cool-down stretches each training day gets (replaces Default stretches).
Stretches are chosen from pools that match that day's focus (upper, lower, core, cardio) instead of the same global list on every day.
Generated weeks save stretch lists on each day, so leg day won't pick arm/chest stretches just because they were in your defaults.

title: Cardio & endurance logging
highlights: Finishing a workout without logging cardio no longer leaves empty jog rows in your session summary.
In-workout cardio uses the same GPS timer, Health Connect import, and distance/time fields as quick log on Today.
Cardio rows match other workout sections—the actions menu is on the left and the checkbox on the right.
